items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Alfred Hirsch, one of the most prominent men in that part of the country

ctx.x: Uh huh. Dewey Luke, Cy Million, all of those fellas banked this Alfred Hirsch, one of the most prominent men in that part of the country. Uh huh. And very rich, a multi-millionaire owned the Tivoli Club. Uh huh. And we were the first band that played there. In about five months or something like that, we got this offer to go on the road with this unit that was leaving the Sanger Theater for the summer. In that unit was six girls in a line. It was no burlesque or nothing like that. It was just strictly a tab,…
